## 型

### Deferred

```emela
effect Deferred[A]
```

A box for one value of type `A`. dbg shows the capability as `<deferred>`.

- `fn complete(value: A) -> Bool`

  Puts `value` in the box and returns True the first time. Afterwards does nothing and returns
  False. Does not suspend.
- `suspend fn await() -> A`

  Waits until the box has a value, and returns it. Any number of tasks may wait on one box.
- `fn poll() -> Option[A]`

  The value if the box has one, `None` otherwise. Does not wait or suspend.

### Deferred

```emela
handler Deferred[A]: Deferred[A]
```

Makes an empty box. Its release does nothing.
